response:
I'm so sorry you're dealing with this heavy weight. It is completely understandable that feeling depressed makes it incredibly hard to go to work or find the energy for daily tasks. When everything feels overwhelming, try focusing on very small, manageable steps rather than the whole day. Sometimes just getting out of bed, taking a shower, or drinking a glass of water is a victory worth acknowledging. Being gentle with yourself and lowering your expectations during this difficult time can help reduce the pressure you might be feeling.

Because this is impacting your ability to work and go about your life, reaching out to a mental health professional or a doctor is a very important step. They can provide a safe space to talk and help you explore treatments like therapy or medication tailored to your needs. You don't have to carry this burden alone, and professional support can be a vital tool in helping you gradually regain your energy and well-being.
